title: Expense decision agent
subtitle: A runnable Decision Agent
description: A DMN business rule table auto-approves or auto-rejects clear-cut expense claims. Only the gray-zone cases it flags as needs-review - foreign currency, borderline amounts, uncovered categories - reach an agent, which converts currency via a real API and reasons over a documented exception before resolving or escalating to a human.
creator: Camunda
thumbnailAlt: BPMN model: an Evaluate expense policy DMN business rule task routing to an Expense Reasoning Agent subprocess or straight to notification, with a human review task for escalated cases.

sampleVariables.label: Clear approve (policy decides, agent never runs)

variables.justification: Team lunch with three colleagues; standard restaurant receipt attached.

sampleVariables.label: Clear reject (policy decides, agent never runs)

variables.justification: Presidential suite booked for a one-night conference stay.

sampleVariables.label: Gray zone, agent resolves (foreign currency + documented exception)

variables.justification: Dinner with a prospective client to close a deal; four attendees, itemized receipt attached.
